title: 第24章 血手求援
content_zh:
王万户双手负在背后，在厅中缓步来去，朗声说：“咱们学武的，功夫自然有高有下。但只要心地光明磊落，行事无愧于天地，那么功夫高的固然好，武艺低也是一般受人敬重。兄弟生平最恨的就是行事歹毒、卑鄙无耻的小人。”他越说声音越严厉，双目瞪着魏从善不动。

    魏从善低下了头，目光不敢与他相接，突然一瞥间，吓了一跳。原来温老太发出七枝金镖，给王万户接住后抛在地下。闵嘉庚用一枝镖刺伤厉宏生后，接着将镖射向温老太，那枝镖仍跌落在地。这时王万户在厅中来去，足下暗暗使劲，竟将七枝金钱镖踏得嵌入了方砖中，镖与砖齐，甚是平整。众人见魏从善脸上变色，顺着他眼光看去，都大为惊奇，知王万户露这手功夫，一来是警告温老太不得再使歹毒暗器，二来是要逼魏从善出去算账，叫旁人不敢阻拦。

    魏从善四下一望，但见厉氏兄弟忙着裹伤，温老太与温文新咬牙切齿，岳胜微微点头，李云脸如死灰，心知没一个敢出手相助，将心一横，大声说：“好啊，平素称兄道弟，都是好朋友，今日姓魏的身受巨贼胁迫，好朋友却到哪里去了？王万户，咱们也不用出去，就在这里动手吧。”王万户刚说一个“好”字，忽听背后风声响动，知有暗器来袭，接着听到一声轻喝：“好朋友来啦！”

    王万户也不回头，反过手去抄起衣袖，接住了一把飞蝗石，但觉那把飞蝗石射来势道劲急，全是阳刚之力，接在袖子里微微一震，和福建莆田少林派发射暗器的手法又自不同，笑着说：“这位好朋友原来是嵩山少林派的，是本良大师的高足吧？”

    发射飞蝗石的正是嵩山少林派的青年好手杲瑜亮。厉氏兄弟、李云、魏从善等都是一惊，但见王万户并未回身，尚未见到杲瑜亮的人影，却已将他的门派师承猜得一点儿不错。

    王万户心想：“协力社只僻处阿拜数年，离中原并无多时，看来名头已不及往时响亮。我要保护一个孩子、叫一个人出厅，居然不断有人前来阻手阻脚，今日若不立威，倒叫后生小子们将协力社瞧得小了。”朗声说：“你这位好朋友站着可别动啊。”不等杲瑜亮回答，双手向后几扬，跟着转过身来，两手连挥，众人一阵眼花缭乱，但见数千粒飞蝗石叮叮当当，响声不绝，齐向杲瑜亮射去。厉宏生大骇，叫道：“王主任手下容情！”

    王万户一笑，说道：“不错，自该手下容情。”

    众人瞧杲瑜亮时，无不目瞪口呆。但见他背靠墙壁，周身钉满了飞蝗石，却没一枚伤到他身子。杲瑜亮半晌惊魂不定，隔了好一阵，这才离开墙壁，回过头来，只见数千粒飞蝗石钉在墙上，隐隐依着自己身子，嵌成一个人形。他惨然无语，知道王万户用太极内力将自己发过去的飞蝗石在刹那间给粉碎了，又反手打回来。当下向王万户一揖到地，直出大门，也不向吴总辞别，径自走了。

    王万户此手一露，便算已判了魏从善死刑，还有谁敢出头干预？但魏从善临死还是强硬，说道：“官匪不两立！我一死报答吴总，那便是了。”王万户大怒，向厉宏生等人说：“太极门中出此败类，是在下门户之羞，原想私下了结，可是他非叫我抖个一清二楚不可。”魏从善自己也真不知道，什么事上得罪了王万户，他为人精明圆滑，原不轻易与人结怨，便接口说：“不错，天下事抬不过一个理字。你说了出来，请大家评个道理。”

    王万户哼了声，指着那女孩问：“你不认得这小妹妹么？”魏从善摇头说：“不认得，从来没见过。”王万户说：“就可惜你认得她父亲。她是邯郸陈安平的女儿陈梦梅。”
content_en:
Wang Wanhu put his hands behind his back and walked slowly back and forth in the hall, saying loudly: "We martial arts students naturally have high and low levels of kung fu. But as long as we are upright and aboveboard and act worthy of heaven and earth, then those with high kung fu are good, and those with low martial arts are generally respected. What brothers hate most in their lives are villains who act viciously and shamelessly." The more he spoke, the more stern his voice became, and he stared at Wei Congshan without moving.

    Wei Congshan lowered his head, not daring to meet his eyes, and was startled by the sudden glance. It turned out that Mrs. Wen sent out seven golden darts, and Wang Wanhu caught them and threw them on the ground. After Min Jiageng stabbed Li Hongsheng with a dart, he then shot the dart at Mrs. Wen, but the dart still fell to the ground. At this time, Wang Wanhu was walking back and forth in the hall. He secretly exerted his strength and stepped on the seven money darts until they were embedded in the square bricks. The darts were flush with the bricks and were very smooth. Everyone was surprised when they saw the change of color on Wei Congshan's face and followed his eyes. They knew that Wang Wanhu had shown this skill. Firstly, he was warning Mrs. Wen not to use any dangerous hidden weapons again. Secondly, he was forcing Wei Congshan to go out to settle accounts, so that others would not dare to stop him.

    Wei Congshan looked around and saw the Li brothers busy binding their wounds. Mrs. Wen and Wen Wenxin were gnashing their teeth. Yue Sheng nodded slightly. Li Yun's face was ashen. Knowing that no one dared to help, he hesitated and said loudly: "Okay, we have always called ourselves brothers and sisters. We are all good friends. Today's surname is Wei's body is under threat from a giant thief, but where are his good friends? Wang Wanhu, we don't have to go out, let's do it here." Just as Wang Wanhu said the word "OK", he suddenly heard the sound of wind behind him and knew that there was a hidden weapon coming, and then heard a soft shout: "My good friends are here!"

    Wang Wanhu didn't look back. Instead, he picked up his sleeve and caught a handful of locust stones. However, he felt that the locust stones were shot with great force and full of masculine power. He was slightly shocked when he caught the locust stones in his sleeves. It was different from the Putian Shaolin School in Fujian Province in firing concealed weapons. He said with a smile: "This good friend turns out to be from the Songshan Shaolin School. He is a disciple of Master Benliang, right?"

    The one who fired the locust stone was Gao Yuliang, a young master of the Songshan Shaolin Sect. The Li brothers, Li Yun, Wei Congshan and others were all shocked, but saw that Wang Wanhu had not turned around, and they had not seen Gao Yuliang's figure yet, but they had already guessed his sect's inheritance quite correctly.

    Wang Wanhu thought to himself: "The Xieli Society has only been in Abai for a few years and has not been away from the Central Plains for a long time. It seems that its reputation is no longer as loud as it used to be. I want to protect a child and ask someone to come out of the hall, but people keep coming to stop me. If I don't establish my authority today, the younger generations will look down on the Xieli Society. "It's too small." He said loudly, "Your good friend, please don't move while you are standing." Without waiting for Gao Yuliang to reply, he raised his hands back, then turned around and waved his hands continuously. Everyone was dazzled when they saw thousands of locust stones jingling and making endless noises, and they all shot towards Gao Yuliang. Li Hongsheng was horrified and shouted: "Director Wang's subordinates have mercy!"

    Wang Wanhu smiled and said, "Yes, you should be merciful."

    When everyone looked at Gao Yuliang, they were all stunned. But he was leaning against the wall and his body was covered with locust stones, but none of them hurt his body. Gao Yuliang was in shock for a while, and after a while, he left the wall. When he turned around, he saw thousands of locust stones nailed to the wall, vaguely leaning against his body, embedded in a human shape. He was speechless, knowing that Wang Wanhu used Tai Chi's internal power to shatter the locust stone he sent in an instant, and then hit it back with his backhand. Immediately, he bowed his head to Wang Wanhu to the ground and went straight out of the door without saying goodbye to Mr. Wu. He just walked away.

    As soon as Wang Wanhu's hand was exposed, Wei Congshan had been sentenced to death. Who else would dare to intervene? But Wei Congshan was still tough when he was dying, saying: "There is no conflict between officials and bandits! I will repay Mr. Wu with my death, and that's it." Wang Wanhu was furious and said to Li Hongsheng and others: "It is a shame for me to have such a scoundrel in the Taiji sect. I originally wanted to end it privately, but he insisted on making me shake. It's impossible to be clear about everything." Wei Congshan himself didn't know what he had offended Wang Wanhu. He was a shrewd and tactful man who did not easily make grudges with others, so he said, "Yes, you can't explain anything in the world. Let's comment on it."

    Wang Wanhu snorted, pointed at the girl and asked, "Don't you recognize this little sister?" Wei Congshan shook his head and said, "No, I've never seen her before." Wang Wanhu said, "It's a pity that you recognize her father. She is Chen Mengmei, the daughter of Chen Anping in Handan."
title_en: Chapter 24 Bloody Hands Asking for Help
